testimonials.quote: Araz Terrace feels like Baku at its most generous — warm light, impeccable kebabs, and a terrace that makes time slow down.
testimonials.author: Sofia Laurent

testimonials.quote: The Shah Plov alone is worth the visit. Elegant without pretension, and service that makes every guest feel celebrated.
testimonials.author: Daniel Whitmore

testimonials.quote: From thyme tea to charcoal grill, every detail carries the spirit of Azerbaijan. Our favorite table in the city.
testimonials.author: Leyla & Amir
